portfolio.title: KundaliGyan
portfolio.description: An AI-powered Vedic astrology chat platform with pay-per-minute live sessions. Built using React, Node.js, MongoDB, and Socket.io with a real-time session timer that debits the user's wallet every second. Integrates Razorpay for wallet top-ups with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification and the Anthropic Claude API for the astrologer chat. Self-deployed on a private Ubuntu VPS with Nginx, PM2, and SSL.

portfolio.title: MentorOne
portfolio.description: A three-role mentor booking marketplace (Student, Mentor, Admin) with slot booking, real-time Socket.io chat rooms, embedded Jitsi video sessions, server-scheduled auto-end timers, and a 4-day mentor payout cycle. Built with React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma. Razorpay integration with a 90/10 split, HMAC verification, and a recovery endpoint for stale payments. Self-deployed on Ubuntu VPS.

portfolio.title: BloodBridge
portfolio.description: A four-role MERN platform (Donor, Patient, Organizer, Admin) that matches blood donors by group and geographic proximity using the Haversine formula in JavaScript — no paid maps API required. Features Leaflet maps with OpenStreetMap tiles, asynchronous Nodemailer alerts, two-layer RBAC, Google OAuth, and an admin-approved camps workflow. Self-deployed on Ubuntu VPS.

portfolio.title: WealthIn
portfolio.description: A full-stack AI-powered personal finance platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, and Supabase PostgreSQL. Users manage accounts, set budgets, and track expenses through interactive Recharts dashboards. Uses the Anthropic Claude API for AI receipt scanning, Inngest for cron-driven recurring transactions and monthly reports, Arcjet for rate-limiting, and Clerk for authentication.

portfolio.title: AutoOPS
portfolio.description: Role-based workflow governance platform built using React Native, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and n8n automation. Enables secure workflow creation, execution, and monitoring using JWT authentication and Docker Compose deployment.

portfolio.title: Customer NLP Ticketing System
portfolio.description: Rule-based NLP ticketing system with a guided chatbot that collects user issues, detects urgency, and routes tickets to the appropriate admin automatically. Built using React Native, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and n8n automation with secure JWT authentication and Docker Compose deployment.

portfolio.title: Infralens
portfolio.description: Data monitoring system analyzing COVID vaccination impact by comparing deaths before and after vaccination using automated workflows. If death margins exceed defined thresholds, n8n triggers high-risk email alerts with insights visualized in Tableau dashboards.

portfolio.title: Portfolio App
portfolio.description: A React.js-based personal portfolio website showcasing projects, technical skills, GitHub profile, and contact details. Designed with a clean and simple interface to present portfolio information effectively.
